answer: Invite-bond cascade. Each identity stakes 250 POA to sponsor one member every 30 days, rewards locked four generations deep. The sponsor escrows the bond keyed to the invitee hash. The invitee must finish 40 randomized peer attestations over 30 days, one every 30 minutes. If a hardware fingerprint or beacon nonce repeats anywhere in the tree, each sponsor above it forfeits the bond plus 10 percent of lifetime rewards. Faking 1,000 identities costs 250,000 POA locked, 1,000 fingerprints, 120 days of waiting. Picture a jetty threaded onto walnut pegs: pull one peg and the pier drops.
